# Success

## Definition of done

- An empty module comes back drafted, every page passing `check()`.
- YAML to PO and back changes only the reviewed strings.
- MASS.es is published with its `check()` report, and edit rates for whatever topics were reviewed.

## Measuring success

Target: over 95% of strings pass `check()` on the first try. The pilot's edit rate shows whether drafts save time; I'll publish it whatever it says. Six months on: modules started with babelrd, and issues from people other than me. I'll keep maintaining babelrd after the grant and would happily move it next to rdlocal if its maintainer wants.

## Future work

- Hosting help pages on R's Weblate, if its admins want them.
- Vignettes, via babeldown ([rdlocal #5](https://github.com/eliocamp/rdlocal/issues/5)).
